filled.notes: 720p VP9, 18 shots, every shot moving: 11 OmniHuman 2.0 talking shots (speakers talk to each other, never to camera) and 7 image-to-video shots (Kling 2.5) plus end card. One video per language: the Welsh video is lip-synced to the Welsh track; the English and Spanish videos carry the same shots with the mouths re-synced to their own track (Kling LipSync). Two date cards: c. 200 BC and c. AD 200; the AD 200 farmer and wife are different people with different voices from the Iron Age couple. cy/en/es subtitles (Welsh and Spanish machine-assisted, for native review).
filled.revision_note: v1.0.0: former Scene 3 (c. AD 200 harvest) merged into Scene 2 as 'The hill before the records'; no narrator or archive bookend; out-of-period line about a round house and the barn removed; every still replaced by moving footage. v1.0.1 (30 Oct 2026): AD 200 farmer and wife recast as different people (4 talking shots + 1 harvest shot re-rendered). v1.0.2 (30 Oct 2026): the last two talking shots had the faces swapped (the wife's line lip-synced on the farmer and the farmer's on the wife, in every track) — fixed; the AD 200 couple re-voiced with voices not used in the Iron Age half (cy/en/es) and their 4 talking shots re-lip-synced; English and Spanish lip-synced videos added.
